t: Forge Steel 8m tape measure set containing 2 measures. Each measure features both metric and imperial scales on a durable, 25mm wide, lacquer-coated carbon steel blade, to provide clear readings and long-lasting performance. The 2m standout reach allows easier single-handed measuring for tasks such as framing, plasterboarding and general construction work, whilst the impact-resistant bi-material case offers protection against drops and knocks. A 3-rivet true zero end hook ensures internal and external measurements are accurate. Ideal addition for any toolkit.
